name: Northern Rocketway Exchange
summary: The Northern Rocketway Exchange is a bustling goblin transit station perched along the cliffside network of Azshara. Constructed as part of the Bilgewater Cartel's ambitious Rocketway system, it serves as a high-speed travel hub and waystation west of Darnassian Base Camp.

sections.title: A Terminal on the Edge
sections.body: The Northern Rocketway Exchange stands as a testament to goblin ambition and questionable safety standards. Stationed along the high-flying tracks of the Bilgewater Cartel Rocketway, this terminal catches travelers who manage to survive the breakneck curves and reckless acceleration of goblin transit cars. Complete with a functioning forge, roaring cooking fires, and mail delivery, it offers a quick respite for travelers navigating Azshara's precarious coastal heights.

sections.title: Comforts and Culinary Risks
sections.body: Beyond serving as a junction point on the Rocketway line, the exchange caters to mechanics and hungry wanderers alike. The local Rocket-jockeys maintain the volatile machinery while travelers warm themselves by the grills, where cooks serve up decidedly unconventional local delicacies. Situated just west of Darnassian Base Camp, it forms a stark, noisy contrast to the ancient elven ruins and wild coastlines that define the rest of the region.

faq.q: What is the Northern Rocketway Exchange?
faq.answer: It is a Bilgewater Cartel transit station along the Rocketway track in Azshara, serving as a transfer depot, repair post, and rest stop for high-speed travelers.

faq.q: Who operates the Northern Rocketway Exchange?
faq.answer: The exchange is operated by the Bilgewater Cartel, complete with goblin Rocket-jockeys, engineers, and station staff who oversee operations.
It is situated along the Rocketway line in Azshara, located immediately west of Darnassian Base Camp overlooking the region's cliffs.
The exchange features basic conveniences for engineers and travelers, including a forge, cooking fires, unusual food grills, and an active mailbox.

angles.text: The Rocketway track and transit cars represent raw goblin engineering at its most brazen, prioritizing breakneck speed and volatile thrills over passenger comfort or structural safety.
The exchange's open grills roast an assortment of bizarre local delicacies that only an adventurous chef or a hardened goblin palate could appreciate.
